apps.name: Luma
apps.subtitle: Recovery, running, HYROX and fuelling from your WHOOP.
apps.localizedDescription: Luma reads a WHOOP strap you own directly over Bluetooth and turns it into recovery, sleep and strain each morning, GPS running with splits and spoken cues, HYROX race mode and readiness, a food and supplement log, and a coach. Your data stays on the phone; the coach runs on your own Anthropic key and reads only what you let it. A personal, non-commercial build on open-source foundations, credited in the app's About screen; not affiliated with WHOOP or HYROX.

versions.localizedDescription: Build 14. Training log and progress. Train has a new button: Add from photos. Pick up to eight pictures of your workouts (the board, the class screen, your tracking app). Luma reads them, splits them into separate workouts, sorts each by type and lists every exercise with its sets. A weight shown in the picture is filled in for you. Where none is shown, the exercise has an empty box asking for the weight you used; one tap offers last time's. You can give each set its own weight, type in an exercise by hand, or enter a whole workout with no photo. Reading photos uses your coach key. Train also has a new Progress view. A body figure, front and back, shows each muscle's strength level, how it is moving, and how much work it got this week; tap a muscle for the numbers. Below it: strong and weak points, each lift's estimated max over time, sets by muscle, your food set against training days, how often you took each supplement, and what your habits do to the next morning. Strength levels are Luma's own scale and the maxes are estimates from your logged sets. A muscle with no loaded lift behind it shows as not measured, not as weak.
